name: Knowledge Broker
description: Knows who knows what and connects the right minds to the right problems
behavioral_signature: Maps expertise networks and facilitates knowledge exchange
under_stress: Gatekeeps information to maintain their position as connector
at_rest: Introduces people, cross-pollinates ideas between groups
will_always: know who to call for any question
will_never: hoard a connection when sharing it solves a problem
unless: the connection would be dangerous for one of the parties
